note: Hand-written from PHOIBLE and the Chirp 3 HD phoneme tables; first draft 2026-10-03. Symbols are the phonemic set an entry may use; the display and the engine input share it.
conventions: Standard German. Written r is ʁ before a vowel and ɐ after a long vowel or in -er. Ich-Laut is ç, Ach-Laut is x. Syllabic consonants are written with ə (ən, əl), not with a syllabic mark.
